content: Te pratiprasava heyah sukshmah. (These subtle afflictions are destroyed by resolving them back into their primal source).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Te pratiprasava heyah sukshmah. (These subtle afflictions ar...) focuses directly on pratiprasava and heyah. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on pratiprasava today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper pratiprasava and heyah in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
